resources.string: Original settings for driving, comfort and infotainment.
Look for Driving assistance, Intelligent driving or Apollo in the original vehicle menu. Available features depend on the model and firmware. Enable them from the original controls.
Open the vehicle menu from the factory panel. This head unit has no public shortcut available to Controls.
Use the original controls for climate, seats, mirrors and lighting. Sound and display options are in the infotainment settings.
Drive modes, regenerative braking and charging are available in the original vehicle menu when supported.
